nom: L’Oreal Paris Collagen Daily Face Moisturizer

segments.oily: A couple of reviewers note the cream can leave a slightly oily-looking finish, and one warns it may feel heavy specifically on oily skin, though it did not cause her breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who calls it the best of the twenty products in her routine, report strong, sometimes instant hydration and softer skin, and several use it as their go-to for dry winter skin or long-standing dryness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly say it hydrates both oily and dry areas without causing breakouts, but one long-time combination/oily-and-dry/sensitive/acne-prone reviewer found it too thick, leaving her face cakey, heavy and oily, and unusable as a day cream.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe sensitive skin, including a couple with eczema, report no irritation, burning or breakouts, especially with the fragrance-free version; dissent includes one review describing redness, a rash and itching across the face, one noting occasional mild stinging after application, and one who broke out after a few weeks of use.
segments.normal: One review notes the cream works well for normal to dry skin but may feel heavy if applied to oily skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 70s report firmer, smoother, more plumped skin with less visible fine lines and wrinkles with continued use, including one 76-year-old who says she has no wrinkles and several who say people guess their age as younger than it is.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it against fine lines and wrinkles, many in their 40s to 70s, report firmer, smoother, more plumped skin and less visible wrinkles with continued use; dissent includes one reviewer who saw no change in elasticity or aging lines, and another who cautions it is not a miracle product and needs to be paired with serums or tretinoin for real anti-aging results.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry or eczema-prone skin, report strong, often fast hydration that keeps skin soft through the day and night; one dissenting review says a recent reformulation no longer lasts, with skin feeling dry again about an hour after application.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports her face turned visibly red and itchy with a rash-like breakout after using the product during the day, having had no reaction using it at night.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer says her skin's barrier noticeably improved with continued use and the product left her feeling oil-free and moisturized; by contrast, another reviewer with sensitive skin reported a red, itchy, rash-like reaction rather than a benefit.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a more even complexion with fewer discolored spots, and some note visibly reduced dark circles and under-eye discoloration with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several with combination or acne-prone skin, report no new breakouts and some note fewer whiteheads or clearer skin overall; dissent includes two reviews describing clogged pores and a cystic pimple, or a breakout appearing after a few weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say it absorbs without leaving a greasy or heavy residue, with several calling it less greasy than other creams they have tried; dissent includes a combination-skin reviewer who found it too thick, cakey and oily to use as a day cream, and another who warns it may feel heavy on oily skin.

aspects.libelle: Thick, rich texture that still absorbs well
Recent reformulation changed scent and feel
Packaging arrives damaged, unsealed or underfilled
Strong value, a little goes a long way
No SPF, so needs separate sunscreen
Works well as a base under makeup

extraits.titre: A review from someone who has tried SO MANY moisturizers!
extraits.texte: I have combination skin that gets super oily, but also super dry (especially with retinol use), sensitive, textured, and acne prone. I am very picky about moisturizers because of how tempermental my skin is. I bought this because I needed a night cream that could moisturize really well. This is my HONEST review of the L'Oreal Collagen Moisturizer. So first of all, the product is reasonably priced but it does come in a pretty small container. It is a thick consistency so a little goes a long way, but it doesn't absorb well enough and leaves my face feeling a bit cakey/heavy/oily. I wouldn't be able to use this as a day cream, because my face would just look too oily and my makeup wouldn't apply well. It moisturizes well, although I was kind of surprised to see that it doesn't say ANYWHERE on the container itself that it's a moisturizer (it just says "moisture filler" which is a little silly and confusing from a marketing standpoint). I don't get breakouts when I use this, but I also don't get any noticeable results from the Collagen claims. I got the scented one because at the time I purchased this there were no unscented options and it is a STRONG lasting smell. The scent is kind of soapy but a bit intense for me... I don't mind using scented products but with this right next to your nose, it can be a tad overwhelming. extraits.titre: Moisturizes well but I think it clogs my pores
extraits.texte: This is Reese's review of L'Oreal Paris Collagen Moisture Filler facial moisturizer. I had a very hard time deciding how many stars to give this product, because I feel that it moisturizes pretty well, better than a lot of moisturizers, but it seems to clog my pores. So I settled on three stars, even though it moisturizers better than those stars would imply. The moisturizer feels smooth and thick when you apply it, and sinks into your face well. I don't feel my face becoming dry or tight hours later. I usually apply this at night, and wake up to skin feeling good and not over dry, which is exactly what I need. But when I use it, it seems like I see more clogged pores in the days afterwards, and sometimes even a deep cystic pimple. I haven't changed anything else about my face care, so I can only attribute it to this product. Overall I really want to love this product and give it a great review, but I can't since I suspect it may be clogging my pores.

extraits.titre: Does what it says it would!
extraits.texte: Love love love the feel and texture of this moisturizer. Truly amazing. The formula/ consistency is thick but light on your skin. It absorbs so well, leaving me oil free and well moisturized and hydrated. It’s truly a standout product. My skin doesn’t feel tight or uncomfortable after application. My skin’s barrier has noticeably improved with continued use. Very effective product, gentle but effective. The only thing I can say that I don’t love about it is the smell. I ordered the fragrance in error. The fragrance isn’t harsh and hasn’t affected my skin, which is surprising. I just prefer to not have fragrances, especially such noticeable ones in my skincare. Value for your money. I love the price point, which I could get a double for the same price. But it’s a really really good product. Not pushing my limits. Price and size are justifiable.

extraits.titre: Soft, hydrated skin without the fragrance!
extraits.texte: I’ve been using the fragrance-free version of this moisturizer and I really like it. It’s super hydrating and leaves my skin feeling soft and a bit more plump when I use it consistently. The texture is on the thicker side, but it absorbs pretty well and doesn’t feel greasy. I also like that it sits nicely under makeup without pilling. Big plus for me is that it’s fragrance-free, so it doesn’t irritate my skin, (I have highly sensitive skin,) or feel overwhelming like some other creams. It might feel a little heavy if you have oily skin, but for normal to dry skin (or colder weather), it works really well. Overall, it’s a great affordable moisturizer…nothing dramatic, but reliable and makes your skin feel healthy. I LOVE this facial moisturizer and I HIGHLY recommend it!

I'm about 30 and I've been struggling with dry skin for the last few years. I get really bad flaky skin around my nose, mouth and cheeks. I have extremely sensitive skin and have resorted to using aquaphor on my face because everything else irritates the crap out of it. I used this lotion on my face last night and this morning before putting make up on and I can already see the difference. My face looks dewy and refreshed. Yes, it is a little sticky and it does have a fragrance to it but, I'm taking the results I'm getting and running with it. I'm very pleased!
